settings.content_1: Lumina currently ships within the United States only. The 7-11 working day estimate includes the time needed to make your blind, dispatch it, and deliver it to your address.
Lumina offers free shipping on all orders, with no minimum spend required.

Because Lumina only operates in the USA, all orders must be placed with a valid US shipping address. We do not support international freight forwarding, cross-border delivery, or non-US billing-to-shipping arrangements at this time.

As soon as your order ships, we will email your tracking number so you can follow the delivery progress. If you believe your order should already have shipped and you have not received a confirmation email, please contact us at
settings.content_3: . Including your order number will help us look into it faster.
